stem: The remaining charge of a small wireless sensor is 240 milliamp-hours when it is switched on, and the remaining charge halves every 6 hours. What is the remaining charge, in milliamp-hours, 18 hours after the sensor is switched on?
solution: In 18 hours there are \(18 \div 6 = 3\) halving periods.

explanation.B: Incorrect. \(120\) is the charge after one halving, at 6 hours.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This divides \(240\) by \(3\), the number of periods; each period divides the charge by \(2\), so the divisor is \(2^{3} = 8\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. \(60\) is the charge after two halvings, at 12 hours; 18 hours is three periods.

verify:
c = 240*Rational(1, 2)**(18/6)
assert c == 30
assert value(choices[answer]) == 30
assert all(value(choices[k]) != 30 for k in choices if k != answer)
